verdict.rationale: Authoring standards-based web components and custom elements is a fair question for a UI framework, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions web components, custom elements, Shadow DOM, or compiling components to custom elements. The evidence covers only React components, Server Components, styling and routing, so there is no support for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can author standards-based web components and custom elements using the framework
